products: OutboundBudget bounding the replaceable class by admitted count and serialized bytes, with LaneLoad reporting admitted and waiting payloads (crates/verter_lsp/src/outbound/mod.rs); control from producers that cannot await its send is ordered and accounted by ControlLane (crates/verter_lsp/src/outbound/control.rs); awaiting control producers and responses are bounded structurally (one message per awaiting producer; LSP_MAX_CONCURRENCY and the zero-capacity response channel) and carry no byte account

Per-document versioned replacement coalescer: ReplaceableLane, the only route publishDiagnostics takes to the client (crates/verter_lsp/src/outbound/mod.rs, consumed by DocumentRegistry::publish_diagnostics)
retiredRoute: DocumentRegistry::publish_diagnostics handing payloads straight to the tower client channel, where a cancelled send left its payload queued and the queue grew by one payload per cancelled publication

cases.binding: crates/verter_lsp/tests/cases/outbound_slow_client.rs (under a stalled reader and edit storm: the admitted high-water reaches and never exceeds the budget; retained payloads, admitted and waiting, stay within the budget plus one payload per document; every document ends on its newest complete set, never older-after-newer) + crates/verter_lsp/src/outbound/tests.rs (message and byte backpressure, waiting payloads accounted, newer epoch retires the older payload while it waits, offer-order admission, pump retirement with the last lane handle, ordered and accounted ControlLane) + documents::diagnostics::tests::a_send_superseded_behind_a_slow_client_never_reaches_it
crates/verter_lsp/tests/cases/outbound_slow_client.rs ($/cancelRequest error and shutdown result arrive behind only what the transport already held, not behind the diagnostics backlog)

crates/verter_lsp/tests/cases/outbound_slow_client.rs (large response delivered whole to a client without partial-result support) + outbound::tests::a_payload_larger_than_the_byte_budget_is_delivered_whole; the server emits no standard partial results
ReplaceableLane is the single replaceable-notification writer; DocumentRegistry::publish_diagnostics is its only producer; no dual live writer

publication incrementality unchanged at the semantic layer (same epoch/receipt fence); the lane only removes superseded payloads. outbound_slow_client compares the full final diagnostic set of every document after the storm with a fresh publication of only the newest epoch through a fresh lane to the same client, contents and ranges included

work-count evidence only: lane high-water and per-document delivered counts are asserted in tests; outbound bytes per run, client application/paint, provider process cost and retained memory are unavailable on the landing worker and are not reported as numbers
not applicable: no new protocol operation is introduced; transport policy only
